sudo -n python3 - <<'PHYSICS_HELPER_REPAIR'
import base64, hashlib, os, stat, tempfile, zlib
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("/home/ubuntu/initialize-private-config.py")
previous_sha = "ee9f178abbff1089c1b8742b161ad859c771e0692df9467f45f82d94d47f2531"
expected_sha = "ba94a5ace59a26cab31b625588d6962b0f81a990694721ce3d2582ba69a30839"
data = zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(""))
if hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() != expected_sha:
    raise SystemExit("HELPER_UPDATE_REFUSED: payload checksum mismatch")
compile(data, str(p), "exec")
if p.is_symlink() or not p.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("HELPER_UPDATE_REFUSED: unexpected file type")
old = p.read_bytes()
actual_sha = hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()
if actual_sha == expected_sha:
    print("HELPER_UPDATED " + expected_sha)
    raise SystemExit(0)
if actual_sha != previous_sha:
    raise SystemExit("HELPER_UPDATE_REFUSED: existing helper differs; do not run it")
metadata = p.stat()
backup = p.with_name("initialize-private-config.before-tty-fix.py")
if os.path.lexists(backup):
    if backup.is_symlink() or backup.read_bytes() != old:
        raise SystemExit("HELPER_UPDATE_REFUSED: backup path already differs")
else:
    fd = os.open(backup, os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL, 0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as output:
        output.write(old)
fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".physics-helper.", dir=p.parent)
try:
    os.fchmod(fd, stat.S_IMODE(metadata.st_mode))
    os.fchown(fd, metadata.st_uid, metadata.st_gid)
    with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as output:
        output.write(data)
        output.flush()
        os.fsync(output.fileno())
    os.replace(temporary, p)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(temporary):
        os.unlink(temporary)
if hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != expected_sha:
    raise SystemExit("HELPER_UPDATE_REFUSED: final checksum mismatch")
print("HELPER_UPDATED " + expected_sha)
PHYSICS_HELPER_REPAIR
